title: 第7590章 故弄玄虚第7589章 九金篁
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
“气运，亦是实力的一部分！世间天才何其多，死在求道路上的也不少，能笑道最后的哪个不是天赋和气运同时傍身？”姬银妍目光一寒。
嗡——
其言语落下，神墟光翼之上的光芒更加炽盛，宛若照耀了半边宇宙！
漫天的金色翎羽以姬银妍手中的九节金篁为中心环绕了起来。
这股力量，甚至将李天命震退了几步，他眼中闪过惊讶之色。
唰唰！
姬银妍目光冷肃，其手中的九节金篁竟然瞬间分裂成了一千根一模一样的巨柱！
“篁影千重！她不仅掌握了这道宝，还在参战之前掌握了这顶尖进化级的战道法！”姬玄鉴眼中都无比惊讶。
这时候，姬银妍身后不远处的四道身影看着这一幕，似乎都有些讶然。
“怎么办？天命哥本就劣势了，对方还拿出了这一招，这可如何是好？”皇甫誉的目光无比担忧。
然而，李天命面对这毁天灭地的一幕，目光却很平静。
实际上，他还没有拿出压箱底的混沌剑道，若是出剑，谁胜谁负尚未可知。
但此刻，他似乎也并没有打算出剑。
其心声道，“棂儿，我不止要赢，更需要绝对压制。”
“来啦。”棂儿的清灵声音在李天命耳边响起。
其话音落下，李天命的身躯瞬间发生了翻天覆地的变化！
一道金光从李天命的后背冲天而起，宛若要将宇宙都捅出一个窟窿来。
而李天命的一头长发，都好似染上了一层金光，呈现出了明亮的银白和金色光泽两种特点。
最重要的是，在李天命气息节节攀升的过程当中，每提升一点力量，其周身的星界神剑和脉场反倒收走一个，循序渐进！
这样一来，众人看到的便只有李天命逐渐将各种种族力量收回自身，有一种融汇力量展现本来实力的假象！

“这是？！”姬玄鉴瞪大了双眼。
万曜等人皆是被震撼到几乎说不出话来，他们都能够感受到，原本就已经无比强悍的李天命，此时变得更加深不可测！
“这是什么手段？！”
这个疑惑充斥在几人的心中。
“故弄玄虚，不过尔尔！”姬银妍冷哼一声，操控着漫天金色棍状巨影落下。
轰轰轰！！！
这每一根巨柱，倾注的都是无比恐怖的宙神之力，这是只有顶级神墟族才能使用的战道法，需要以神墟光翼为媒介，有精准的掌控能力，才能瞬间爆发出恐怖的千重巨影！
在特殊的施展条件下，这门战道法更是直逼进化级之上，也就是永恒级的战道法威力，这也难怪连姬玄鉴都无比震惊。
然而，借助了姜妃棂一丝力量的李天命，竟然收起了东皇剑，赤手空拳地冲向了对方。
他一拳轰出！
噼啪噼啪！！
上百的金篁巨影被碾碎成渣，化作了漫天的星光。
他一脚横扫！
哗啦啦！！
无数金篁巨影七零八落，都失去了与姬银妍的联系。
content_en:
"Luck is also a part of strength! There are so many geniuses in the world, and there are also many who die on the road of pursuit. Who can laugh and say that the last one is not blessed with both talent and luck?" Ji Yinyan's eyes turned cold.
Buzz——
After his words fell, the light on the Shenxu Light Wings became even brighter, as if it illuminated half of the universe!
The sky full of golden feathers surrounded the nine-section golden bamboo in Ji Yinyan's hand.
This force even knocked Li Tianming back a few steps, and a look of surprise flashed in his eyes.
Swish!
Ji Yinyan's eyes were cold and solemn, and the nine-section golden bamboo in her hand instantly split into a thousand identical giant pillars!
"Huang Ying Qianzhong! Not only did she master this Taoist treasure, but she also mastered this top evolutionary level battle method before joining the battle!" Ji Xuanjian was extremely surprised in his eyes.
At this time, the four figures not far behind Ji Yinyan looked at this scene and seemed a little surprised.
"What should we do? Brother Tianming is already at a disadvantage, and the other party still uses this move. What should we do?" Huangfu Yu's eyes were extremely worried.
However, Li Tianming's eyes were calm when faced with this devastating scene.
In fact, he has not yet taken out the Chaos Kendo that is at the bottom of the box. If he does use the sword, it is still unclear who will win and who will lose.
But at this moment, he didn't seem to be planning to draw his sword.
He said in his heart, "Ling'er, I not only want to win, but I also need to be absolutely suppressed."
"Here we come." Ling'er's clear voice sounded in Li Tianming's ears.
As soon as he finished speaking, Li Tianming's body underwent earth-shaking changes!
A ray of golden light shot into the sky from Li Tianming's back, as if it was going to poke a hole in the universe.
Li Tianming's long hair seemed to be dyed with a layer of golden light, showing bright silvery white and golden luster.
The most important thing is that in the process of Li Tianming's aura rising steadily, every time he increases his strength, one of the astral divine swords and pulse fields around him is taken away, step by step!
In this way, what everyone saw was that Li Tianming gradually took back the power of various races into himself, giving the illusion of integrating power to show his original strength!
"This is?!" Ji Xuanjian's eyes widened.
Wan Yao and others were so shocked that they were almost speechless. They could all feel that Li Tianming, who was already extremely powerful, became even more unfathomable at this time!
"What kind of method is this?!"
This doubt filled the minds of several people.
"It's just a mystery, no matter what!" Ji Yinyan snorted coldly and controlled the giant golden stick-shaped shadow in the sky to fall.
Boom boom boom! ! !
Each of these giant pillars is filled with the extremely terrifying power of the God of the Universe. This is a battle method that can only be used by the top Shenxu clan. It requires the use of Shenxu Light Wings as a medium and precise control ability to instantly erupt into a terrifying thousand-layered giant shadow!
Under special conditions, this battle method is even more powerful than the evolutionary level, that is, the eternal level battle method. It is no wonder that even Ji Xuanjian is extremely shocked.
However, with the help of Jiang Feiling's strength, Li Tianming actually put away the Donghuang Sword and rushed towards the opponent with bare hands.
He punched out!
Crack, crackle! !
Hundreds of giant golden shadows were crushed to pieces and turned into stars that filled the sky.
He swept with a kick!
Wow! !
Countless giant golden shadows were scattered, and they all lost contact with Ji Yinyan.
